MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The eight-port switch fits my recent Ethernet adapter and patch cables: it would help me connect several devices at my desk.",
    "The USB extension cables offer useful extra reach for my peripherals, which fits my history of making connections easier around my workspace."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The graphics card, CPU cooler, memory kit and internal SSD assume an upgrade project I have not shown a need for; owning gaming accessories or memory cards does not establish that need or compatibility.",
    "The DVI and DisplayPort cables solve connection needs I have not shown, while five display cables and a 24-port switch exceed the scale of my apparent setup.",
    "Another HDMI cable is relevant to my equipment, but I already have one and would need a specific longer connection to justify buying another."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in desktop components, even though my purchases mostly support connecting, organizing and maintaining devices.",
    "Buying a cable or adapter seems to have been treated as a reason to want more connection products regardless of connector type, quantity or whether I already have the function covered."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet purchases give me a concrete reason to consider a modest switch; they do not suggest I need a large network installation.",
    "The particular job matters: a memory card for a Garmin device does not imply a need for internal computer storage, and a useful cable depends on the ports and reach I actually need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical device connections but extended it too far into unneeded upgrades, unsupported connectors and oversized equipment."
}
